name: Scapula & Shoulder
description: Scapula & Shoulder program for the left shoulder — AAROM flexion and external rotation, scapular rowing, and internal rotation ROM. Assigned by Lee Rosenzweig on 06/25/26.
author: Lee Rosenzweig

phases.name: Scapula & Shoulder
rules: Perform all exercises as instructed by your therapist
Movements should feel like a gentle stretch, not sharp pain
Use the right arm to assist the left during AAROM exercises
Return slowly to the starting position after each rep

exercises.name: Shoulder Flexion AAROM with Opposite Arm - Left
exercises.description: Starting Position: Lie on your back with your left arm resting on a towel, and your elbow bent. Grasp your left wrist with your right hand. Action: Using your right arm to assist, raise your left arm up, straightening your elbow. Then move your left arm overhead until you feel a gentle stretch in your shoulder. Hold as instructed. Return to the starting position.
cues: Lie on back, left arm on towel, elbow bent
Grasp left wrist with right hand
Right arm assists left arm up and overhead
Gentle stretch in shoulder — hold 10 sec
Return slowly to start

exercises.name: Shoulder External Rotation AAROM with Cane in Scapular Plane - Left
exercises.description: Starting Position: Lie on your back with your left arm resting on a towel slightly away from your side, and your elbow bent. Hold a cane or stick with both hands with your left palm facing your body. Action: Using your right hand to assist, gently push the cane or stick in order to rotate your left hand and forearm away from your body. Hold as instructed. Return to the starting position.
cues: Lie on back, left arm on towel, slightly away from side
Hold cane with both hands, left palm facing body
Right hand pushes cane to rotate left forearm outward
Hold 10 sec
Return slowly to start

exercises.name: Row
exercises.description: Starting Position: Attach a resistance band to a fixed object in front of you. Stand facing the bands and hold one end in each hand with your arms straight. Action: Tighten your abs and squeeze your shoulder blades together and down as you pull your elbows back towards your sides. Return to the starting position.
cues: Band anchored in front, one end in each hand
Arms straight to start
Tighten abs
Squeeze shoulder blades together and down
Pull elbows back to sides, then return

exercises.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation ROM Towel Pass - Left
exercises.description: Starting Position: Stand with your feet hip width apart. Hold a towel roll in your left hand. Action: Bring your left arm behind your back until you feel a gentle stretch in your left shoulder. Take the towel with your right hand, bring it back in front of your body and pass it back to your left hand.
cues: Stand feet hip width apart, towel roll in left hand
Bring left arm behind back
Gentle stretch in left shoulder
Pass towel to right hand, bring to front
Pass back to left hand and repeat
